what: Gzipped bytes of everything the build emits, in two groups. INITIAL is the entry script plus the stylesheet, which a visitor downloads before anything is interactive. DEFERRED is every other chunk Rollup splits out, today the lazily loaded constellation frame and the three.js it imports. Measured by scripts/battery.mjs with Node zlib gzipSync at its default level.
baselineRound: game-feel Round 6 (the first measurement that counts both shipped chunks)
budgetNote: Threshold set from the Round 2 baseline with headroom for the Web Audio effects module (Round 4d), the outcome cinematics (Round 5) and the procedural music bed (Round 6). Round 3 spent 5072 bytes, Round 3.5 spent 384, Round 4a nothing, Round 4b spent 1122, Round 4c spent 39 net, and Round 4d spent 3477: twenty four synthesized voices, the engine that owns the context and the gesture unlock, the two persisted toggles and the severity mapping. No audio assets, so nothing here is a fetch or a license. The dev sound board is excluded from the build and the battery checks the built output for its marker. jsdom is a dev dependency and adds nothing here. Any library addition records its delta here in its own commit. Round 4e spent -14: the reduced-motion speed coupling and its mid-session effect came out, and nothing was added to the shipped bundle; the fixture is a test. Round 5 was given a sub-budget of 9,000 gzipped in brief v1.3 and spent 718 of it: four scenes rendered from one component with no new assets and no new dependency. The scene ANIMATIONS live in the stylesheet, which this budget does not measure (it measures the main JS chunk); src/index.css grew 1,817 bytes raw, and the built CSS chunk is 6,676 gzipped in total.
headroomNote: Headroom is not recorded here. It is derived by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs from the chunk the battery just measured, because a written headroom describes the baseline it was written against and goes stale the moment a round grows the bundle; Round 4c copied a stale one into its report twice.
correctionNote: Corrected twice at the opening of Round 6. First: the budget counted the entry SCRIPT alone from Round 2 onward, so the stylesheet shipped unmetered and the headroom everyone reasoned from was 11,485 when the initial figure was 4,828. Round 5 is the clearest case, recording 834 gzipped against a 9,000 sub-budget while index.css grew 1,817 raw bytes nothing counted. Second, and larger: that fix anchored both patterns to the entry chunk name, so the lazily split Constellation chunk stayed invisible. It is 129,274 gzipped, almost the whole of the rest of the game, and no budget had ever seen it. The layer enumerates the directory now and treats anything it cannot classify as deferred rather than as nothing.
thresholdNote: 140,000 on the INITIAL download is KEPT rather than raised: it still fits at 4,828 of room against a music bed estimated at 1,500 to 2,500, and raising a budget at the moment it begins to bind is how budgets stop working. The DEFERRED budget of 132,000 is new and is set just above what is already there, so the chunk cannot grow in silence; it is not an endorsement of the figure. 129,274 gzipped of three.js for a decorative start-screen frame is a live question for the author, not a settled one, and it is recorded here so the next round argues it rather than inherits it.
